title: 1Password acquires Apono, which operates an AI-powered platform for managing cloud access, sources say in a deal valued at $250M to $300M (Meir Orbach/CTech)
summary: Meir Orbach / CTech: 1Password acquires Apono, which operates an AI-powered platform for managing cloud access, sources say in a deal valued at $250M to $300M — AI-era identity security startup joins the Canadian cybersecurity giant as it expands beyond password management into access governance.
